facts.clause: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy.
The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside.
Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed.
Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
